title: Pistachio Cobbler
description: A sweet dessert featuring a crust of american biscuits topped with a pistachio filling.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the quaint and sweet.
Add the pistachio and mix until well combined.
Roll out the american to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Transfer the crust to a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Spread the pistachio mixture evenly over the crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream, if desired.
